details.name: Finding the Smallest Divisor of a Positive Number
details.description: Construct a program that finds the smallest divisor (other than 1) of a positive number. For example, the smallest divisor of 4 is 2.

details.name: Finding the Largest Divisor of a Positive Number
details.description: Construct a program that finds the largest divisor of a positive number, excluding the number itself. For example, the largest divisor of 24 is 12.
